title: Tarball extraction keeps a relative symlink that stays inside the top directory
objective: In src/wev_skills/third_party/fetch.py, install_version(source, release: Release, home: Path, opener, runner) extracts a GitHub release tarball under home/<source>/<version>. Make it accept an archive whose member `top/.opencode/skills` is a symlink with target `../skills/` (pointing at `top/skills`, where `top/skills/a/SKILL.md` exists) and extract it with the link in place, resolving to a path inside the version directory. Links that would resolve outside the top directory must still be refused with CheckFailed("unsafe_member").
